yy.g: Hashem — Onkelos writes יְיָ both for the Name and for אֱלֹהִים

elohim.g: Elohim — kept as in the Hebrew where it follows יְיָ

shry.g: to dwell, rest; to begin; (Af'el) to settle, place

hzy.g: to see; (Itpe'el) to be seen, appear

yat.g: marks the direct object (= Hebrew אֶת)

avr.g: to pass, cross; (Af'el) to cause to pass

qbl2.g: to receive, accept; (לְמֵימַר) to listen to

name.g: a name, kept as in the Hebrew

mna.g: to hold back; (Itpe'el) to be held back, prevented

lhod.g: alone, only (with a suffix: by himself)

kns.g: to gather; (Itpa'al) to be gathered together

ylf.g: to learn; (Pa'el) to be accustomed, practise (Af'el) teach

qrb.g: to come near; (Pa'el) to bring near, touch

ad.g: until, up to; (עַד לָא) before, not yet

tsurta.g: form, design (צוּרַת כְּרוּבִין = a design of cherubim)

ty.g: to go astray; (Af'el) to lead astray, deceive

plh.g: to work, till; to serve, worship

qwm2.g: to establish, fulfil; (Itpa'al) to endure, last

gzr.g: to cut; to make (a covenant); to circumcise; (Itpe'el, Itpa'al) to be circumcised

meimra.g: word; (of Hashem) His Word, the Memra

el.g: God (a Hebrew word kept by Onkelos in אֵל עִלָּאָה)

bdr.g: to scatter; (Itpa'al) to be scattered, spread out

tba.g: to seek, demand; to call to account

shbq.g: to leave, let go; to forgive

gly.g: to uncover, reveal; to go into exile; (passive participle) revealed, known

rwm.g: to be high; (Itpe'el) to be lifted up

ry2.g: to be pleased with, desire, accept favorably

trk.g: to drive out, banish; (passive participle) divorced woman

havra.g: companion, fellow (גְּבַר לְחַבְרֵיהּ = one to another)

qamohi.g: the day before (lit. from before it)

sdr.g: to arrange, set in order (סְדַר קְרָבָא = to join battle)

sar.g: to visit (punish); (Af'el) to bring (sins) to account

shlm.g: to be finished, come to an end

shabbta.g: Sabbath; rest (שְׁבַת קוּדְשָׁא = a holy rest)

yqr2.g: to be heavy; (of eyes) to be dim

tqn.g: to prepare, set right; (Itpa'al) to adorn oneself

dts.g: to fix, stick in, set up

msr.g: to hand over; (passive participle) handed over, given
